changelog: Four distinct bank interfaces (Fleeca, Maze Bank, Pacific Standard, Bank of Liberty), each with its own look and real perks.
Banking at another bank's branch shows a comparison banner and lets you switch banks on the spot.
Four ATM designs by brand; withdrawing at another bank's ATM costs an out-of-network fee, shown before you confirm.
New 'Banks' admin tab to edit names, colours, skin, icon, fees and perks, plus ATM and branch branding, live.
Fixed ATM sounds stopping after a few clicks, admin panel buttons breaking on names with quotes, and windows overflowing small screens.
